name: dWo
caption: DECW's own dominant heel stable of December 1997, four wrestlers deep, billed together as "the entire dWo" on the fed's first televised card.

tenures.source: DECW Monday Night War Hour #2, 23 December 1997: "the entire dWo makes their way to the ring. Carolina Bandit, Scottland Brawler, Da Iceman, and The Amazing TuthPicBoy are on their way."

name: The Blazerz
caption: A tag team of Black Blaze and White Blaze, defeated on DECW's first televised card and eliminated together in the first round of its inaugural tournament.

tenures.source: DECW Monday Night War Hour #1, 23 December 1997.
